hints.title: Boundary Constraints
hints.text: The pattern requires finding exactly three consecutive digits not flanked by other numbers.

hints.title: Regular Expression Anchors
hints.text: Ensure the 3-digit sequence is bounded by non-digit characters or string boundaries.

hints.title: Sorting
hints.text: Filter matching rows and sort output by product_id in ascending order.

hints.title: Reference Implementation
hints.text:
```sql
SELECT product_id, name 
FROM Products 
WHERE name REGEXP '(^|[^0-9])[0-9]{3}([^0-9]|$)'
ORDER BY product_id ASC;
```

variables: n: number of products in table
complexity.notes: Regular expression scan across all product names.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Loose digit checks match numbers with four or more digits.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(n) space stores filtered result set.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Applies precise regex anchoring for exact 3-digit sequences.

solutions.code:
SELECT product_id, name 
FROM Products 
WHERE name REGEXP '(^|[^0-9])[0-9]{3}([^0-9]|$)'
ORDER BY product_id ASC;

SELECT product_id, name 
FROM Products 
WHERE name ~ '(^|[^0-9])[0-9]{3}([^0-9]|$)'
ORDER BY product_id ASC;
